newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS CLEARED TO PLAY PSG IN PALERMO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS CLEARED TO PLAY PSG IN PALERMO.

text.p: European Cup holders Juventus will play their European Supercup second leg against Paris St Germain in Sicily on February 5 instead of their northern home city of Turin.

The serie A leaders, who made the second leg largely academic by thrashing the French team 6-1 in the first leg this month, had asked European soccer's ruling body UEFA to allow them to play the match in Palermo.
UEFA said in a statement on Tuesday that it had allowed the the move to ensure a good turnout for the game, after seeking the French club's agreement.

It said the decision to play in the south was intended to promote the Supercup and should guarantee a turnout of around 40,000 at the city's La Favorita stadium instead of the pitifully small attendance expected in Turin.
Juventus, winners of the Italian league a record 23 times, have long been more Italy's soccer team than that of Turin where Torino have traditionally enjoyed greater support.
They have also been in dispute for some time with Turin authorities over the costs of playing in the cavernous Delle Alpi stadium, which the city council owns.
They also have a strong following in the south which, apart from Napoli, lacks any serie A clubs.
